metadata.description: MCP server for Angi — find home-service pros by trade and city, read ratings, reviews and pro profiles. Angi serves its pages only to a real browser, so requests route through the user's own angi.com tab via the fetchproxy browser extension, reusing their existing session. The trade/city taxonomy is read from Angi's public sitemaps directly.

plugins.name: myatriumhealth-mcp
plugins.description: Read MyAtriumHealth (Epic MyChart) records — test results, medications, allergies, immunizations, health issues, visits — by relaying requests through the user's signed-in browser tab via the fetchproxy bridge.
